meta.title: Countering on a column that is not negotiable is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the “counter the vendor's price” request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot give a counter offer on these columns.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Countering on a column that is not negotiable is refused

expected.message: You cannot give a counter offer on these columns.
